draft.subject: intake without extra hires
draft.body:
Hi Paul,

A different angle. Firms that move intake onto private AI handle 4–8x more enquiries with the same staff.

We're a 17+ person team of engineers, AI specialists and analysts, based in San Jose.

Is growing intake without growing headcount a priority for you?
